waivers.reason: D3 is a NUP2105L dual ESD clamp in SOT-23 on B.Cu, one channel used (CC2; issue #133, docs/boards/lite-esd.md). hwde's cpl_verify does not model JLC's bottom-side convention, so every bottom part is 'bottom_unverified'. Pins 1 and 2 are identical channels to the common pin 3, so a mirror that swaps 1 and 2 changes nothing. What matters is that pin 3 lands on the lone pad (GND): confirm that in JLC's bottom-side preview at order.

waivers.reason: U10 is a USBLC6-2SC6 (SOT-23-6) on B.Cu under J1 (USB D+/D-; issue #133, docs/boards/lite-esd.md). hwde's cpl_verify does not model JLC's bottom-side convention, so every bottom part is 'bottom_unverified'. A left-right mirror only swaps the two identical I/O channels (1/6 and 3/4), which is harmless. A 180 degree turn or a top-bottom mirror would swap pin 2 (GND) and pin 5 (VBUS, open here) and leave the clamp without ground: at order, confirm in JLC's bottom-side preview that pin 1 is the corner pad nearest the board edge on J1's right-shell side (pad 1, no net; seen from the top at 84.05/61.65) and that pin 2 lands on the middle pad wired to J1's shell pin 3.
